title: Honda "third clutch" automatic transmission: class action settlement (2002-2004)
summary: Honda service bulletin 21-054 notifies dealers of the Third Clutch Transmission Settlement for 2003-04 Accord V6, 2002-04 Odyssey and 2003-04 Pilot.

specs.name: Case
specs.value: Case v. American Honda Motor Co., Inc., No. BC 424169

specs.name: Benefit options
specs.value: Reimbursement of out-of-pocket parts cost for full transmission replacement, or a $25 credit voucher for Honda parts/accessories (labor not covered)

body: The earlier draft of this entry listed symptoms and covered Acura models and 1998-2004 Accords. Those claims were removed because no source has been cited for them yet.

sources.title: A21-054: Class Action Notification Mailing: Third Clutch Transmission Settlement

author: OpenBay
